fact: As updated on 29 June 2026 the Banking Commission's list for Guinea-Bissau shows one payment institution, INTOUCH Guinée-Bissau (EP.GB.001/2025), and one e-money institution, Finances Mobiles Bissau (EME.GB.021/2023).
title: Listes des établissements de paiement et de monnaie électronique - Guinée-Bissau
